messages:
Cara (Finance): AP flag on Stratovex invoice SVX-2026-112 — bot says PO not matched and vendor EIN doesn't line up with vendor master. Any quick context? :mag:

Jonah (AP): invoice-bot hold: REASONS=[PO_MISMATCH, VENDOR_ID_MISMATCH, UNAPPROVED_LINE_ITEM]. Invoice lists PO 7099 but our active PO for Stratovex is 7098. Also invoice shows a 'resilience surcharge' $450 not in SOW. Need reissued invoice or formal docs.

Leah (Vendor Ops): I pinged Stratovex; they merged billing entities and auto-assigned PO 7099. They uploaded a short "billing consolidation" note but it's unsigned. Asked them to either (A) reissue under PO 7098 and legal name Stratovex LLC, or (B) provide a signed consolidation memo referencing both POs and authorized signatory.

Marcus (Procurement): We require a signed consolidation memo for PO transfers. Doc must state: "Stratovex LLC authorizes consolidation of invoices from PO 7098 to PO 7099" with signature + date. No retroactive consolidation without Procurement approval.

invoice-bot: Invoice SVX-2026-112 uploaded by Leah; status -> HOLD (PO_MISMATCH, VENDOR_EIN_MISMATCH). Ticket AP-8437.

Stratovex Billing (via Leah): "We will reissue SVX-2026-112v2 under PO 7098 and remove the resilience surcharge for this invoice. We'll also send a signed consolidation memo for future invoices. Apologies for the confusion." (attachment: svx-2026-112v2.pdf)

Jonah (AP): Received SVX-2026-112v2 and verified PO 7098 + vendor name matches vendor master. Removed surcharge line; amounts reconcile. Routing for payment. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:

Cara (Finance): Thanks. Marcus, can Procurement require signed consolidation memos before accepting any future PO shifts? We should also log this incident for vendor onboarding checklist.

Marcus (Procurement): Yes — updated vendor onboarding: "If vendor consolidates billing entities or POs, require signed consolidation memo and updated W-9/EIN docs before AP will accept invoices under new PO." Logged AP-8437 for audit.

Leah (Vendor Ops): Closing loop with Stratovex and asked them to submit the consolidation memo before next cycle.

Cara (Finance): Marking resolved. Noting that any surcharge/extra fees require a signed amendment validated by Procurement & Finance before AP will pay.
